newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: One dead as gunman takes hostages in Swiss bank.
newsitem.headline: One dead as gunman takes hostages in Swiss bank.

text.p: One person died when an armed man took over a bank in the Swiss city of Lucerne on Wednesday and took hostages before the siege ended, local police said.
"I can confirm one person is dead," a police spokesman told Reuters, adding that a suspect was in custody. But he declined to give any other details.

A Reuter photographer at the scene said police led a man in his underwear and with a bag over his head away from the building after the standoff at Bank Regio in the picturesque town in central Switzerland often visited by tourists.

Shots were fired inside the building during the early morning attack, a police spokesman said. The hostage-taker, who police said spoke broken German, had demanded one million Swiss francs ($700,000) in ransom.
It was not immediately clear how many hostages the gunman had seized. The Swiss SDA news agency said he had taken two people hostage and had wounded another.
Security forces cordoned off the bank building and positioned snipers on neighbouring rooftops, police said.
